mapper.select: SELECT ps.product_id, ps.stock, ps.version, ps.update_time, p.product_name FROM product_stock ps LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id WHERE ps.product_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_stock (product_id, stock, version, update_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{stock}, #{version}, #{updateTime})
